newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LPMO to seek 8,443T of frozen beef.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LPMO to seek 8,443T of frozen beef.

text.p: South Korea's Livestock Products Marketing Organization (LPMO) would invite tenders to buy 8,443 tonnes of frozen beef at 2.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Tuesday, an official at the organisation said on Monday.
The official said acceptable origins were set for the United States, Canada, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Japan, New Zealand, Australia, Finland, Mexico and the Netherlands.
If it passes on the tenders in whole or partially on Tuesday due to high prices, it will re-invite the tenders on Friday.
